heart_guide_help: Follow the circuit between the body, heart, and lungs, then explore the chambers and valves.
heart_guide_marker_help: Match the numbered markers to the structure key.
heart_guide_orientation: In this schematic, the right heart appears on the left side of the illustration.
heart_guide_circuit_svg_description: The circuit traces oxygen-poor blood from the body through the right heart to the lungs, then oxygen-rich blood through the left heart and aorta back to the body.
heart_guide_chambers_svg_description: A magnified schematic shows the right atrium, right ventricle, left atrium, and left ventricle. Chamber shape and valve highlights follow the selected circulation step.
heart_guide_valve_help: Valve highlights follow the selected circulation step.
heart_guide_focus_return: Right atrium · Tricuspid valve · Venae cavae
heart_guide_focus_outflow: Right ventricle · Pulmonary valve · Pulmonary arteries
heart_guide_focus_inflow: Pulmonary veins · Left atrium · Mitral valve
heart_guide_return_detail: Oxygen-poor blood returns from the body through the superior and inferior venae cavae and enters the right atrium.
heart_guide_outflow_detail: Blood crosses the tricuspid valve into the right ventricle, then passes through the pulmonary valve and pulmonary arteries to the lungs.
heart_guide_inflow_detail: After gas exchange, oxygen-rich blood returns through the pulmonary veins and enters the left atrium.
heart_guide_systemic_detail: Blood crosses the mitral valve into the left ventricle, then passes through the aortic valve and aorta to supply the body.
heart_guide_clinical_change: The aortic valve opening narrows, increasing resistance to left-ventricular outflow.
heart_guide_clinical_effect: The left ventricle must generate higher pressure and may thicken over time.
heart_guide_clinical_note: Educational comparison only — not a diagnostic view.
heart_guide_handoff_context: move into the air-blood barrier where pulmonary capillary blood gains oxygen.
heart_guide_handoff_announcement: Opening alveolar oxygen diffusion, step 2 of 4.
